comment: Pinned upstream revision that every file:line citation in this repo refers to.
Line numbers drift as master moves, so citations are only meaningful against a fixed
commit. CI checks citations against this pin as a hard gate, and separately warns when
master has moved away from it (see .github/workflows/verify.yml).
To move the pin: update 'sha' to the release tag commit, run tools/verify.sh, and fix stale claims.
